Overview of CLAT 2026 Admission Notification

The Common Law Admission Test (CLAT) notification has been released for undergraduate and postgraduate law course admissions. The application window opened on August 3, 2026, and prospective candidates can submit their forms online until October 31, 2026. This examination facilitates admission to integrated BA/LLB (Hons) and LLM programs across participating institutions.

Key Dates and Application Timeline

Candidates intending to apply for the upcoming admissions cycle must take note of the established deadlines:

  • Application Start Date: August 3, 2026
  • Last Date to Apply Online: October 31, 2026
  • Last Date for Online Fee Payment: October 31, 2026
  • Result Declaration Date: To be announced

Fee payments can be processed securely through online digital methods, including debit cards, credit cards, internet banking, IMPS, and mobile wallets.

Eligibility Criteria and Academic Requirements

Applicants must meet specific educational qualifications depending on the course level they are targeting:

  • Undergraduate (B.A./LLB Hons): Candidates must have passed or be appearing in the 10+2 (Intermediate) examination from a recognized board in India. General category applicants require a minimum of 45% marks, while reserved category candidates require a minimum of 40% marks.
  • Postgraduate (LLM): Candidates must hold or be in the final year of an LLB degree from a recognized university in India. General category applicants need a minimum of 55% marks, whereas reserved category applicants require at least 50% marks.

Practical Implications and Reader Verification

When navigating entrance examinations, applicants should carefully review official guidelines before submission.

  • What is Confirmed: The application period runs from August 3, 2026, to October 31, 2026. The basic percentage criteria for general and reserved categories are clearly established for both UG and PG programs, and digital payment methods are accepted.
  • What Remains Unknown: Specific dates for the result declaration and detailed age-limit parameters are not fully detailed in the primary announcement and require checking the official portal.
  • How to Verify: Readers can verify all application details, syllabus guidelines, and official notifications directly on the official CLAT website at https://consortiumofnlus.ac.in/clat-2026/.
